task_description: Write a method in Dafny to extract specified size of strings from a given sequence of string values.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method ExtractStrings(seq: seq<string>, size: nat) returns (extracted: seq<string>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The length of the returned sequence is equal to size
- All elements in the returned sequence are consecutive elements from the input sequence
- The returned sequence is a subsequence of the input sequence
- The extracted strings are exactly those starting from some position in the input sequence, maintaining their original order
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method ExtractFirstNStrings(seq: seq<string>, n: int) returns (result: seq<string>)
    
Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - n should be non-negative
    - n should not exceed the length of the input sequence
    
Dafny specification:
    requires n >= 0
    requires n <= |seq|
    
Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The result sequence contains the first n strings from the input sequence
    
Dafny specification:
    ensures |result| == n
    ensures result == seq[0..n]
    
Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method ExtractFirstNStrings(seq: seq<string>, n: int) returns (result: seq<string>)
    requires n >= 0
    requires n <= |seq|
    ensures |result| == n
    ensures result == seq[0..n]
{
    result := seq[0..n];
}
```
